description: MainApplication.java is a Java source file for an Android application built with React Native. It sets up the React Native environment, manages package inclusion, and initializes debugging tools like Flipper.

classes.name: MainApplication
classes.description: The main application class for the Android app, extending Application and implementing ReactApplication to set up React Native environment, package management, and debugging tools.

methods.name: getReactNativeHost
methods.description: Returns the ReactNativeHost instance managing the React Native environment.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes native libraries, updates controller, and Flipper debugging tool during app startup.

methods.name: initializeFlipper
methods.description: Uses reflection to initialize Flipper debugging tool in debug mode.
